name: k8s
description: My personal Kubernetes cluster running SideroLabs Talos OS via Omni and managed by ArgoCD

paragraphs: This is the Git repository that contains all the configuration for my multiple homelab Kubernetes clusters. The clusters are used to host a number of self-hosted services mostly focused on movies and TV show management Linux ISOs along with all the supporting software. This repository is fully gitops-optimized and is managed by ArgoCD.
The clusters are built on Sidero Lab's Talos OS using on-prem Omni for low-level cluster management.

I started with Docker containers on Raspberry Pis several years ago and as my usage grew, so did my desire to make things more resilient to failures. I eventually moved away from Docker on a single RPi to K3S on two or three mini-PCs. That eventually grew into its current iteration on 7 mini-PCs using Talos. It has proven to be extremely stable and resilient to hardware failures. Day-to-day management is minimal.
